audience: people teams and managers who run check-ins, goals and reviews in 15Five

useCases.title: See which check-ins are due
useCases.text: List the check-ins filtered by user and due date. Open one check-in to read its answers.

useCases.title: Review company objectives and their progress
useCases.text: List the objectives and open one to see its key results and progress. List the departments for context.

useCases.title: Find peer recognition and weekly priorities
useCases.text: List high fives, filtered by receiver or source check-in. List the weekly priorities filtered by user, manager or group.

useCases.title: Track review cycle completion
useCases.text: List the participants and reviews of one review cycle to find who has not finished. Needs review admin access on the key creator's account.

useCases.title: Plan the week around 1-on-1s and vacations
useCases.text: List the 1-on-1 meetings between managers and reports. List the vacation and time-off records of users.
